notes.title: Demo Release v0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]DEMO OUT NOW![/h3]

This is the first release out for the early supporters of our game! Thank you so much for being an awesome part of this experience with us, we proudly present our first playable version of WTTB!ːsteamthumbsupː

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Inventory system: open with I
[*] Skill menu: Open menu with J.
[*] Notification system
[*] 20+ Items / Weapons
[*] Fully improved the player health system
[*] Fixed most bugs related to saving and loading
[*] Improved Entity AI
[*] Added save deletion button (will be improved later)
[*] Reworked UI
